task_description: Build a Digimon-style monster raising web game from scratch: React+Vite frontend (S3+CloudFront), AWS Lambda+API Gateway backend, DynamoDB save data, Amazon Bedrock conversational AI with model selection by growth stage (baby=none, rookie=Haiku, champion=Sonnet, ultimate=Opus), and AWS CDK one-command deploy. Growth = egg->baby->rookie->champion->ultimate, evolution by training count + elapsed time, simple ATK/DEF/HP stats, care (feed/train/sleep/clean), simple battles, SVG monster art, no auth (browser-generated monsterId). Japanese UI. Quality gates adapted to a no-network sandbox: shared pure-logic unit tests + tsc syntax checks; full build/cdk synth documented in README for the user.
session2_review: v4 semantic review APPROVED (.agents/tasks/task-digital-monster/2026-10-04-162340-review.md), first pass. Two minor non-blocking issues noted: (1) foundation-model IAM ARN uses wildcard region bedrock:*::foundation-model/... - required for us. cross-region inference profiles, still limited to the 3 specific model IDs and only the chat Lambda, not a real over-grant; (2) battleLog turn-line regex uses greedy (.+) name captures - a monster name containing ' hits '/' for ' could misparse a log line (garbled, never crashes); enemy name is app-controlled. Neither blocks the demo.
